nodes.name: Email Job Post Draft to Recruiter

parameters.content:
## Sourcing — what is and isn't automated

LinkedIn and Bayt do not offer public APIs for posting jobs or for automated candidate search/messaging (headhunting) — that requires their paid Talent Solutions / Recruiter products, separate from normal API access. So:

- **Job-board applicants**: fully automatic. This inbox watcher reads new application emails and the agent takes it from there.
- **Headhunting**: recruiter still finds and messages the candidate on LinkedIn manually, then logs them with the form below — everything after that (scoring, Notion record, call booking) is automatic.
- **Job ad posting**: still manual (see the "Draft Job Post" section) — the agent writes the ad copy, you paste it into Bayt / LinkedIn Jobs yourself.

## Screening & interest-gated booking

Every sourced candidate gets an AI fit score (0-100) against the target job title. Score ≥ 65 sends a personalized outreach message (Email now; WhatsApp needs a real phoneNumberId + an approved Meta message template — currently disabled, see the WhatsApp node) with a "Yes I'm interested" link. Only when the candidate clicks that link does the agent check real calendar availability across the next 10 working days (Sun–Thu, 9:00–17:00 Riyadh) and auto-book the first free 30-min slot — see the 'Candidate Confirmed Interest' section below. If nothing is free, the recruiter is notified to book manually and the candidate is told someone will follow up.

## Post-call evaluation

Recruiter only fills this in after conducting the actual screening call (the human part). The agent finds the Notion record, saves the evaluation, and — only if the recommendation is "Push to Client" — emails the client contact with the candidate profile automatically.

## Job post drafting (bonus)

Since auto-posting to job boards isn't possible via API, this gives recruiters an AI-written, ready-to-paste job ad on demand instead.

parameters.content:
## Candidate clicks "Yes, I'm interested"

This is the GET link sent in the outreach email/WhatsApp: `/webhook/candidate-interested?id=<Notion page id>`. On click: looks up the candidate, scans the team calendar for the next 10 working days, and books the first free 30-minute slot automatically — no fixed/guessed time like before. If nothing is free in that window, the recruiter gets an email to book manually and the candidate sees a "we'll follow up" message instead of an error.
